AIRING OUT A BOATHOUSE FOR A NEIGHBORHOOD NEWSLETTER.  

THE BOATHOUSE WAS LEFT UNCOVERED FOR A LONG TIME. NOW IT IS BEING AIRING OUT TO PREVENT MOLD AND DUST.  

LOCAL RESIDENTS ARE BEING INVITED TO HELP. THEY CAN VISIT THE BOATHOUSE AND HELP CLEAN IT OUT.  

THIS IS A GOOD WAY TO KEEP THE BOATHOUSE CLEAN AND SAFE FOR ALL.  

LET'S WORK TOGETHER TO MAKE THE BOATHOUSE A BETTER PLACE TO LIVE.
